subject: qplot: order of ordered factor ignored when faceting

messages.author: af62644095cc2666
messages.subject: qplot: order of ordered factor ignored when faceting
parts:
qplot seems to ignore the order of an ordered factor which is used of
an faceting variable, arranges the panels in alphabetic order instead.
For eg.

cab<-c('C','A','B')
f<-ordered(rep(cab,5),levels=cab)
x<-rep(1:5,each=3)
y<-1:15
qplot(x,y,facets=.~f)

Produces three panels in the order 'A','B','C', ignoring the levels of
the factor f.

On the other hand with the same variables:
d<-data.frame(x,y,f)
qplot(x,y,facets=.~f,data=d)

produces the panels in the order 'C','A','B' which is what I had
expected.

I came across this problem while trying to create a seasonal time
series plot and getting my months in alphabetical order.

Looking at the source of qplot the culprit seems to be
facetsdf <- as.data.frame(sapply(facetvars, get))
where the sapply seems to be throwing away the factor information.
Don't know how to fix this though.

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: qplot: order of ordered factor ignored when faceting
parts:
Hi Jyotirmoy,

Thanks for the bug report. The fix is:

names(facetvars) <- facetvars
facetsdf <- as.data.frame(lapply(facetvars, get))

and I'll be in the next version of ggplot2.

Hadley
